raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`top_logprobs_num` is a public logprob request parameter on the native `/generate` path. OpenAI `/v1/completions` `logprobs` and `/v1/chat/completions` `top_logprobs` are converted into the same internal field.

The tokenizer-side admission path validates `token_ids_logprob`, but it does not validate `top_logprobs_num`. The scheduler later calls `logprobs.topk(max_k, dim=-1)`, where the last dimension is the model vocab size. If one request asks for more top logprobs than the vocab contains, PyTorch raises `RuntimeError: selected index k out of range`; that scheduler exception triggers process-tree shutdown and makes the server unavailable for later requests.

I reproduced this on current main with a single native `/generate` request using `top_logprobs_num=100000` against a 32000-token vocab: the attack request disconnects, the server exits with `-9`, and both `/health_generate` and a normal `/generate` fail afterward.

## Modifications

- Add `_validate_top_logprobs_num` in `TokenizerManager`.
- Call it next to the existing `token_ids_logprob` validation for `GenerateReqInput`.
- Reject bool, non-integer, negative, and above-vocab values before the request reaches the scheduler.
- Keep `0 <= top_logprobs_num <= vocab_size` valid.
- Add focused unit coverage in the existing TokenizerManager unit test file.

## Testing

Real server before/after on A800-SXM4-80GB with `/root/autodl-tmp/models/tinyllama-w4a16-channel-v2`:

| Request | Current main | This patch |
|---|---|---|
| `/generate`, `top_logprobs_num=100000` | request disconnects, server exits `-9`, later requests fail | HTTP 400, health OK, later request OK |
| `/v1/completions`, `logprobs=100000` | same logprob path | HTTP 400, health OK, later request OK |
| `/v1/chat/completions`, `top_logprobs=100000` | same logprob path | HTTP 400, health OK, later request OK |

<details><summary>repro (server command, payloads, full output)</summary>

Environment:

- Hardware: NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB, CUDA SM80
- SGLang base: `3cb29f674`
- Model: `/root/autodl-tmp/models/tinyllama-w4a16-channel-v2`
- Vocab size: 32000
- Python: 3.12
- PyTorch: 2.11.0+cu130

Server:

```bash
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/tinyllama-w4a16-channel-v2 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 31028 \
  --attention-backend triton \
  --sampling-backend pytorch \
  --disable-cuda-graph \
  --disable-piecewise-cuda-graph \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.5 \
  --dtype float16 \
  --max-running-requests 8
```

Native attack payload:

```json
{"text":"Hello","sampling_params":{"max_new_tokens":4,"temperature":0},"return_logprob":true,"top_logprobs_num":100000}
```

OpenAI completions attack payload:

```json
{"model":"/root/autodl-tmp/models/tinyllama-w4a16-channel-v2","prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":4,"temperature":0,"logprobs":100000}
```

OpenAI chat attack payload:

```json
{"model":"/root/autodl-tmp/models/tinyllama-w4a16-channel-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":4,"logprobs":true,"top_logprobs":100000}
```

Current main, native `/generate`:

```text
MARKER_BASELINE_OK
MARKER_ATTACK_SENT gen_toplp
MARKER_ATTACK_RESULT gen_toplp status=None dt=5.1s body=RemoteDisconnected: Remote end closed connection without response
MARKER_HEALTH_AFTER gen_toplp fail:None
MARKER_NORMAL_AFTER gen_toplp fail:None body=URLError: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>
MARKER_SERVER_EXIT gen_toplp -9
MARKER_DOS_CONFIRMED gen_toplp (server_exit=-9 health=None normal=None)
```

This patch, all three public entrypoints:

```text
MARKER_BASELINE_OK
MARKER_ATTACK_SENT gen_toplp
MARKER_ATTACK_RESULT gen_toplp status=400 dt=0.0s body={"error":{"message":"top_logprobs_num must be in [0, 32000], got 100000."}}
MARKER_HEALTH_AFTER gen_toplp ok
MARKER_NORMAL_AFTER gen_toplp ok
MARKER_SERVER_EXIT gen_toplp running
MARKER_ATTACK_SENT comp_logp
MARKER_ATTACK_RESULT comp_logp status=400 dt=0.0s body={"object":"error","message":"top_logprobs_num must be in [0, 32000], got 100000.","type":"BadRequestError","param":null,"code":400}
MARKER_HEALTH_AFTER comp_logp ok
MARKER_NORMAL_AFTER comp_logp ok
MARKER_SERVER_EXIT comp_logp running
MARKER_ATTACK_SENT chat_toplp
MARKER_ATTACK_RESULT chat_toplp status=400 dt=0.0s body={"object":"error","message":"top_logprobs_num must be in [0, 32000], got 100000.","type":"BadRequestError","param":null,"code":400}
MARKER_HEALTH_AFTER chat_toplp ok
MARKER_NORMAL_AFTER chat_toplp ok
MARKER_SERVER_EXIT chat_toplp running
```

</details>

Additional checks:

```bash
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py -q
black --check python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py
isort --check-only python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py
ruff check python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py
git diff --check
python -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py
```

Results:

```text
pytest: 13 passed
black: 2 files would be left unchanged
isort: passed
ruff: passed
git diff --check: passed
py_compile: passed
```

## Checklist

- [x] Format the code according to SGLang style.
- [x] Add focused unit tests for the admission guard.
- [x] Validate the behavior through a real server before/after repro.
- [x] Documentation is not needed for this request validation fix.
- [x] Accuracy and speed benchmarks are not needed because this does not change model outputs or inference code.

cc @hnyls2002 @cctry

files.patch:
@@ -1363,6 +1363,7 @@ def _validate_one_request(
         # Validate generation-specific fields
         if isinstance(obj, GenerateReqInput):
             self._validate_token_ids_logprob(obj)
+            self._validate_top_logprobs_num(obj)
             requested_hidden_mode = get_request_return_hidden_states_mode(
                 obj.return_hidden_states
             )
@@ -1499,6 +1500,20 @@ def _validate_token_ids_logprob(self, obj: GenerateReqInput) -> None:
                     f"{token_id}; valid range is [0, {vocab_size})."
                 )
 
+    def _validate_top_logprobs_num(self, obj: GenerateReqInput) -> None:
+        top_logprobs_num = obj.top_logprobs_num
+        if top_logprobs_num is None:
+            return
+        if isinstance(top_logprobs_num, bool) or not isinstance(top_logprobs_num, int):
+            raise ValueError("top_logprobs_num must be an integer.")
+
+        vocab_size = self.model_config.vocab_size
+        if top_logprobs_num < 0 or top_logprobs_num > vocab_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"top_logprobs_num must be in [0, {vocab_size}], "
+                f"got {top_logprobs_num}."
+            )
+
     def _create_tokenized_object(
         self,
         obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput],

@@ -147,6 +147,8 @@ def _make_tokenizer_manager(case) -> TokenizerManager:
     tm.dump_requests_folder = ""
     tm.crash_dump_folder = ""
     tm.send_to_scheduler = MagicMock()
+    tm.model_config = MagicMock()
+    tm.model_config.vocab_size = 32000
     return tm
 
 
@@ -227,6 +229,34 @@ def _make_batch_str_output(rid: str, finished_reason=None) -> BatchStrOutput:
     return BatchStrOutput(**kwargs)
 
 
+class TestTokenizerManagerLogprobValidation(CustomTestCase):
+    """Test request-level logprob parameter validation."""
+
+    def test_rejects_top_logprobs_num_above_vocab_size(self):
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        obj = GenerateReqInput(
+            text="Hello", return_logprob=True, top_logprobs_num=32001
+        )
+
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "top_logprobs_num"):
+            tm._validate_top_logprobs_num(obj)
+
+    def test_rejects_negative_top_logprobs_num(self):
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        obj = GenerateReqInput(text="Hello", return_logprob=True, top_logprobs_num=-1)
+
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "top_logprobs_num"):
+            tm._validate_top_logprobs_num(obj)
+
+    def test_accepts_top_logprobs_num_at_vocab_size(self):
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
+        obj = GenerateReqInput(
+            text="Hello", return_logprob=True, top_logprobs_num=32000
+        )
+
+        tm._validate_top_logprobs_num(obj)
+
+
 class TestEngineResponseWait(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
     def setUp(self):
         self.tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(self)
